title: Past simple for holiday stories
main_aim: By the end of the lesson learners will be able to tell a partner about a past holiday using regular and irregular past simple verbs
subsidiary_aims: Listening for gist and specific information

stages.name: Lead-in
stages.procedure: Ss guess where T went from three photos

stages.name: Listening for gist
stages.procedure: Ss listen and choose the best photo

stages.name: Clarification
stages.aim: Clarify meaning, form and pronunciation of past simple

stages.name: Controlled practice
stages.procedure: Gap-fill in pairs, then check answers with the key

stages.name: Freer practice
stages.procedure: Ss tell a partner about a holiday

problems.solution: Irregular verb list on the board; drill
